scope: Questions ranked before drafting the late-2040s revision; answers and evidence are added after the research and article are complete.

questions.question: What does protium fusion consume and produce, and why would it be useful?
Why is ordinary hydrogen harder to burn in a reactor than familiar fusion fuels?
Which systems were deployed in the late 2040s, where and by whom?
How does an opaque catalytic pulse retain radiation and complete its fuel cycle?
How does the electron-poor titanium cycle convert hydrogen into helium?
What did the deployments achieve by the end of 2049, including net output and system mass?
Which problems proved most serious, and what fixes, delays or deratings followed?
What did better simulation accelerate, and what still limited construction and commissioning?
How did the economics compare with deuterium fusion and solar power?
What applications justified further work, and which later developments remained open in 2049?
